## Judgment

Drift on sweet16 and petunia only, as expected. Both enable the new option nix-nexus.nix.buildKvm.enable (modules/core/nix-build-kvm.nix, a contribution to core-nix). It adds one udev rule: ACTION=="add|change", KERNEL=="kvm", RUN+="setfacl -m g:nixbld:rw /dev/kvm". /dev/kvm stays 0660 root:kvm. The same commit removes the nixbld kvm group of b81b118: the Linux sandbox of Nix 2.35.2 calls setgroups(0, 0) before it makes the user namespace, so the group never reached a build (probe build on sweet16 after the 37c1f7d deploy: open of /dev/kvm denied, groups=nixbld only). Evaluated on both hosts: the udev rule is present, nix.settings.system-features keeps nixos-test, benchmark, big-parallel and kvm, users.users.nixbld1.extraGroups is ["nixbld"]. No other config changed (avina, hermes and home configs show no drift).
